text: Mouser Electronics is a subsidiary of TTI, Inc.: Berkshire Hathaway's annual report for 2025 describes TTI's business and refers to 'its Mouser subsidiary'.

source.name: Berkshire Hathaway Inc.: Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025 (SEC)
source.quote: Its Mouser subsidiary supports a broader base of customers with lower volume purchases through internet-based marketing
